sam: noticed a short burst of 99th tail in eu-west-1 at 02:03 UTC. traces show a rapid sequence of per-host warmup fanouts.
tanya: any agent logs?
sam: snippet: ```
[2026-04-02T02:03:12Z] host=eu-west-1b warmup_fanout=172 queued_replies=9
[2026-04-02T02:03:12Z] host=eu-west-1b kv_cache_regen=1
```
raj: warmup_fanout that high will steal cycles; we've seen shared tenants suffer.
tanya: did router send dedicated fallbacks into that host?
sam: yes one fallback landed there and got ~220ms extra tail.
raj: idea: add a transient soft-quarantine flag for hosts with warmup_fanout>120 for 45s. router should avoid non-critical tenants and prefer warm hosts.
tanya: cost? avoiding hosts reduces packing, but quarantine window is short. small headroom (~3%) should do it.
sam: pseudocode: ```
if host.warmup_fanout_recent > 120:
  host.tags.add("soft_quarantine_45s")
  router.exclude(host, unless tenant.critical)
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling agent v2.14.3 observed; no global alerts.
raj: action items: (1) metric TTL 60s, (2) router FF + canary in eu-west-1, (3) alert: inferred_throttle > 2% for 5m -> page infra-sre.
tanya: i'll own the metric + dashboard. sam will run the canary.
sam: will run canary at 08:00 UTC and post results. :thumbsup:
